scientificNotes: The rust-removal experiment distinguishes observation from explanation and includes both Fe2O3 + 6HCl and Fe + 2HCl reactions.
The lesson explicitly avoids the overgeneralization that every acid reacts with every metal to produce hydrogen.
Concentrated sulfuric acid dilution is treated as a safety-critical procedure and is not presented as an optional memorization point.
